SHOW CONTROL / 02

Direct the sky.

Your aircraft. A whole new stage. Launch a performance, step inside the swarm, and capture the show.

Four looping performances with changing formations. Every light is an aircraft with its own flight path and battery.

Choose a performance to launch the current fleet.

Camera direction

3D cameras and scenery need WebGL. This browser is showing the tactical map; performances still run.

Overview

Eye height: 1.7 m. Drag the field to look. Click the field, then WASD / arrows to walk, or hold these buttons.

Stage & atmosphere
Drone lighting

Night show dims the stage and keeps beacon colors distinct. Light spill illuminates nearby aircraft and surfaces; low flights add soft ground pools.

Physical materials, sky reflections, soft shadows and HDR bloom. Performance reduces rendering cost; every drone is still simulated.

Capture a performance

Records the camera with optional sound and HUD. Stop to save; clips remain available until you leave this page. Maximum 5 minutes / 256 MB.

Cinematic cycles through an orbit, wing chase, formation sweep, onboard FPV, spectator and overhead shot. Pausing holds the automatic camera; reduced motion holds automatic cuts.

01 / FLEET BUILDER

Build your cluster.

Choose 0–10,000 individually simulated aircraft. Build, choose a show, then launch.

Fleet configuration

Rebuild resets this practice run. Six starters = four Scouts + two Relays.

Individual aircraft & group colors

Eight colors + white. Group buttons use names as well as color.

Battery & field testing

Finite battery is on by default. Low power recalls aircraft; empty batteries land them. Recharge parked aircraft to fly again. Test controls lock during scored rounds.

Start with six drones to inspect flight, or build a larger swarm for formation and light-show experiments.

02 / FLIGHT PROGRAM

Give the swarm a shape.

Choose what you want the fleet to do. Advanced controls are optional.

Presets & flight scripts

Dance to a beat
120 BPM · beat off

Tap with music or enter its BPM, then Apply. Zero stagger synchronizes the whole fleet. The optional click follows the program clock; no song analysis is performed.

One fleet. Every word.

Your aircraft travel between words, hold each message, then continue. No respawning between cues.

HELLO → WORLD
Single word instead

Up to 16 letters or numbers. More drones make clearer letters. Choose Front / words above the field.

Drag for separate strokes. Keyboard: arrows move, Space adds a point, Enter starts a new stroke. Up to 24 strokes / 512 points.

Boids & independent effects

Advanced influences & formulas

Use x, y, z, t, i, n, phase, pi, tau; sin, cos, sqrt, abs, min, max, atan2 and arithmetic. Displacement is capped at 32 m.
Placement & timing
Script reference

Select all, scouts, relays, cargo, engineers, alpha–delta, any beacon color, or drone-001. Empty named groups are skipped. The Addressed group limits which drones the script controls.

select all
assign formation
formation ring
height 32
origin fixed
influence riemann 14 0.5
wait 12
show dance
repeat 32

assign: formation, operator, bike, scout, relay, standby. formation: ring, wedge, line, grid, word, drawing. word HELLO · plane sky · trace off · scale 3 · move 0 -25 · pattern orbit · show flyby. Custom fields: influence custom 8 0.6, then formula x = 6 * sin(t + i). Beat timing: beat on, bpm 120, offset 0. wait advances the timeline; repeat is the final command. Layering: layer 2 wave 8 0.6 · layer 3 vortex 5 0.4 · layer 2 none · pattern none · reset effects. Boids: boids on · boids none · reset boids · boidCohesion 0.6. The legacy script anchor “bike” now means the charger; “operator” means the control station. Numeric controls include patternSpeed, patternAmount, showSpeed, showAmount, phase2, blend2, variance, phaseVariance, speedVariance, seed and axisX/Y/Z. 96 lines / 600 seconds maximum.

Apply restarts the program clock. Launch all brings docked drones into the air. Other groups keep their last positions or assignments.

0 POINTS

    Color hunt: select the requested color below the field, then Scout objective. Recall each delivered group before sending the next. Correct drones +10; complete a color +25; wrong colors −2 each. Roster and field options lock during scored rounds.

    Keep the good ones.

    Saved on this browser. Up to 20 named fleets. Loading starts a fresh run with the saved setup.

    Word sequence
